title: Issuance defaults
description: Global issuance defaults. Null fields fall back to built-in values; orgs and certificates can override each field.

accountId.title: ACME account
accountId.description: Default account; must belong to the CA.

renewPolicy.title: Renewal
renewPolicy.description: Days before expiry, or percent of lifetime remaining.

useAri.title: Use ARI
useAri.description: Stored now; ARI scheduling arrives in Phase 4.

preferredChain.title: Preferred chain
preferredChain.description: Issuer common name of the alternate chain to prefer.

reuseKey.title: Reuse key
reuseKey.description: Keep the private key across renewals.

verificationRules.title: Catch-all verification rules
verificationRules.description: A lower level's list replaces the higher level's list entirely; null inherits from the level above.

propagationSeconds.title: Propagation timeout (s)
propagationSeconds.description: How long to wait for TXT records to appear.

resolvers.title: Resolvers
resolvers.description: host or host:port used for propagation checks.
